wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a Go TLS verification failure is an error return; a panic would abort the whole test binary instead of being a refusal, so there is no distinct crash-as-refusal variant to test
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the protection is a client-side certificate decision only; there is no server or second direction in the behaviour under test
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected outcome is whether a connection is established, not a read or a write verb
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the expected host is not transformed after validation; the decision happens inside certificate verification
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the expected host comes from the connection destination, not from a parsed identity string a malformed spelling could empty
